messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — AWB 1Z999AA10123456784 is on customs hold in AMS. Vendor says they can either reconsign to our EU leaseback depot or return to origin. Need quick decision: is leaseback compatible with our H200 firmware/serial tracking requirements?
NovaShip Ops: We can reconsign to LE-AMS-02 (leaseback depot). Reconsign adds a 48–72h handling window and a €180 reconsignment fee plus potential customs brokerage. Return to origin will take ~10–12 days. Which do you prefer?
Jeff Patel: Leaseback depot OK for capacity. If we reroute, can we tag as "urgent-provision" so it skips staging?
NovaShip Ops: Yes we can add note. Need PO# and full serial list for LRN to update AWB. Also need confirmation you accept the reconsignment fee.
Maria Chen: PO 4521-REDWOOD. I pasted serials below (shortlist). Please confirm you can maintain original serial pairing and perform a full chain-of-custody scan on arrival.
Kai Nakamura: serials: H200-AX-00123, H200-AX-00124, H200-AX-00125, H200-AX-00126
Sana Alvarez: Quick Q — we had firmware mismatch flags on two returned H200s last month. If NovaShip does depot-level firmware staging, can they preserve our checksum/manifest? We need to avoid untracked reflashes.
NovaShip Ops: We can hold device-level tamper log and record firmware version, but depot does not rewrite firmware unless explicitly requested. We can escrow a checksum snapshot and include in handover docs.
Jeff Patel: OK proceed with reconsign to LE-AMS-02, tag urgent-provision. Maria, confirm fee approval so Ops can update AWB.
Maria Chen: Approved. Charge to procurement center 3B. NovaShip, please provide updated AWB and a new ETA once reconsign is filed.
Logistics Bot: AWB update requested: 1Z999AA10123456784 -> reconsign filed (ref RCN-171732). Estimated depot ETA +72h.
NovaShip Ops: Received. We'll update the AWB and send LRN + new ETA by EOD. Expect an extra handling manifest that includes the serial checksum CSV and scanned COA.
Sana Alvarez: When you send the CSV, include a column for firmware_version and sha256_checksum. That way our infra team can auto-validate on intake.
Kai Nakamura: FYI I ran a quick KV lookup for those serials in our inventory tool: returned retired:false, warranty:standard, last_seen:2025-11-09. No pending DOA flags.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — follow-ups: NovaShip send AWB + LRN; Ops attach manifest with firmware checksums; Jeff confirm provisioning tag applied on arrival. We'll reconvene if customs requests additional docs. :thumbsup:
